slots.title: Cancer or not? A Mohs surgeon's two-spot quiz
slots.claim: The mole that worries you is usually the harmless one; the dangerous spot is the one that looks unlike all the others.

beats.close: If one of your spots looks like none of your others, that is the one to show a dermatologist. Not a photo to a stranger online.

slots.title: Should you start Botox at 24?

beats.middle: What he sees in patients who started early: the ones who did well used small doses only where a line was forming; the ones who did badly chased a frozen look and lost expression. He says plainly that baby Botox is just a smaller dose.
beats.close: His rule: treat a line when it stays after your face relaxes, not because a friend started. A consult should be allowed to end with no.
